what.text: This page follows refugees from Armenia living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6656 Armenian refugees in France, 42.7% of all refugees from Armenia.
France is the largest host of Armenian refugees, followed by Germany, the United States and Belgium.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Armenia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2011 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 463 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
